import io = "./obj_io.qui"
import measure = "./measure.qui"
import repair = "./repair.qui"
import orientation = "./orientation.qui"

bool has_int(int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

bool has_string(string[] values, string target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

int[] numbers(int count)
    int[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index <= count
        result = result.append(index)
    return result

int[] unique_sorted(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if not has_int(result, value)
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

class Query(string kind, int[] args)
class Settings()
    spacing := 1
    merge := true
    degenerate := true
    duplicates := true
    orient := true
    outward := true
    fill_holes := 0
    keep_unused := true
    sections := ["summary", "components"]
    Query[] queries := []

Settings read_parameters()
    settings := Settings()
    for line := io.read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        name := words[0]
        if name == "query"
            int[] args := []
            for: 2 <= index < int(#words)
                args = args.append(io.decimal(words[index]))
            settings.queries = settings.queries.append(Query(words[1], args))
        elif name == "sections"
            settings.sections = words[1:<int(#words)]
        elif name == "snap"
            settings.spacing = io.decimal(words[1])
        elif name == "fill_holes"
            settings.fill_holes = io.decimal(words[1])
        else
            enabled := words[1] == "on"
            if name == "merge"
                settings.merge = enabled
            elif name == "degenerate"
                settings.degenerate = enabled
            elif name == "duplicates"
                settings.duplicates = enabled
            elif name == "orient"
                settings.orient = enabled
            elif name == "outward"
                settings.outward = enabled
            elif name == "keep_unused"
                settings.keep_unused = enabled
    return settings

bool polygon_nonplanar(int[] corners, int[][] points)
    origin := points[corners[0] - 1]
    total := [0, 0, 0]
    for: 1 <= index < int(#corners) - 1
        direction := measure.cross(measure.subtract(points[corners[index] - 1], origin), measure.subtract(points[corners[index + 1] - 1], origin))
        for: axis < 3
            total[axis] += direction[axis]
    for vertex := corners[]
        if measure.dot(measure.subtract(points[vertex - 1], origin), total) != 0
            return true
    return false

string edge_shape(int[] edge, int[] adjacent, int[][] faces, int[][] points)
    if #adjacent != 2
        return "-"
    first := faces[adjacent[0] - 1]
    second := faces[adjacent[1] - 1]
    if orientation.has_directed(first, edge[0], edge[1]) == orientation.has_directed(second, edge[0], edge[1])
        return "inconsistent"
    third := 0
    for vertex := second[0:<3][]
        if not has_int(edge, vertex)
            third = vertex
    sign := measure.dot(measure.subtract(points[third - 1], points[first[0] - 1]), measure.normal(first, points))
    return if sign < 0 then "convex" elif sign > 0 then "concave" else "flat"

orientation.topology.Loop[] coherent_loops(int[][] faces, int[][] edges, int[][] edge_faces, int[][] boundary_edges)
    loops := orientation.topology.trace_loops(edges, boundary_edges)
    for: index < int(#loops)
        loop := loops[index]
        if loop.kind == "closed"
            forward := 0
            for: int position < loop.length
                first := loop.vertices[position]
                second := loop.vertices[(position + 1) % loop.length]
                edge := orientation.topology.edge_index(edges, first, second)
                if orientation.has_directed(faces[edge_faces[edge][0] - 1], first, second)
                    forward += 1
            loop.kind = if forward == 0 or forward == loop.length then "coherent" else "mixed"
            if forward == 0
                loop.vertices = loop.vertices[0:<1].concat(loop.vertices[1:<loop.length][::-1])
        loops[index] = loop
    return loops

class Component(int number, int[] faces, int[] vertices, int[] edges)
    int[] boundary := []
    int[] nonmanifold := []
    int[] bad_vertices := []
    closed := false
    manifold := false
    consistent := false
    solid := false
    orientable := false
    loops := 0
    euler := 0
    genus := 0
    crosscaps := 0
    int[] inside := []
    volume6 := 0
    real64 surface_area := 0.0
    normal_sum := [0, 0, 0]
    int[] bounds := []
    string[] center := []
    shapes := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    angles := [0, 0, 0]
    edge_min := 0
    edge_max := 0
    valence_min := 0
    valence_max := 0

class Data(io.Source[] sources, Settings[] parameters)
    int[][] snapped := []
    int[] snap_records := []
    int[] representative := []
    int[][] triangles := []
    int[][] removed := []
    string[] reasons := []
    int[][] points := []
    int[] renumber := []
    int[][] faces := []
    string[] face_groups := []
    initial_faces := 0
    orientation.topology.Mesh[] meshes := []
    inconsistent_before := 0
    int[] inconsistent_after := []
    orientation.topology.Loop[] loops_before := []
    added := 0
    outward_components := 0
    flipped_faces := 0
    bool[] nonplanar := []
    string[] groups := []
    Component[] components := []

Data analyze(io.Source source, Settings settings)
    data := Data([source], [settings])
    snapped := repair.snap(source.vertices, settings.spacing)
    data.snapped = snapped.points
    data.snap_records = snapped.changed
    data.representative = repair.representatives(data.snapped, settings.merge)
    data.triangles = repair.split_polygons(source.polygons, source.polygon_lines)
    cleaned := repair.clean(data.triangles, data.snapped, data.representative, settings.degenerate, settings.duplicates)
    data.removed = cleaned.removed
    data.reasons = cleaned.reasons
    present := array(#source.vertices, fill = false)
    if settings.keep_unused
        for: index < int(#data.representative)
            present[index] = data.representative[index] == index + 1
    else
        for face := cleaned.faces[]
            for vertex := face[0:<3][]
                present[vertex - 1] = true
    data.renumber = array(#source.vertices, fill = 0)
    for: index < int(#present)
        if present[index]
            data.points = data.points.append(data.snapped[index])
            data.renumber[index] = int(#data.points)
    int[][] initial := []
    for original_face := cleaned.faces[]
        face := original_face
        for: axis < 3
            face[axis] = data.renumber[face[axis] - 1]
        data.faces = data.faces.append(face)
        data.face_groups = data.face_groups.append(source.polygon_groups[face[4] - 1])
        initial = initial.append(face)
    data.initial_faces = int(#data.faces)
    before := orientation.topology.analyze(data.faces, int(#data.points))
    data.inconsistent_before = int(#orientation.inconsistent(data.faces, before.edges, before.edge_faces))
    current_faces := data.faces
    if settings.orient
        orientation.repair(&current_faces, before.edges, before.edge_faces)
    data.faces = current_faces
    data.inconsistent_after = orientation.inconsistent(data.faces, before.edges, before.edge_faces)
    loops := coherent_loops(data.faces, before.edges, before.edge_faces, before.component_boundary)
    permitted := array(#before.component_faces, fill = true)
    for: number < int(#permitted)
        if #before.component_nonmanifold[number] > 0
            permitted[number] = false
    for edge := data.inconsistent_after[]
        permitted[before.face_components[before.edge_faces[edge][0] - 1] - 1] = false
    for: index < int(#loops)
        loop := loops[index]
        if loop.kind == "coherent" and loop.length >= 3 and loop.length <= settings.fill_holes and int(#unique_sorted(loop.vertices)) == loop.length and permitted[loop.component - 1]
            added_faces := repair.filling(loop.vertices)
            data.faces = data.faces.concat(added_faces)
            for _ < int(#added_faces)
                data.face_groups = data.face_groups.append("fill")
            data.added += int(#added_faces)
            loop.filled = true
            loops[index] = loop
    data.loops_before = loops
    mesh := orientation.topology.analyze(data.faces, int(#data.points))
    data.meshes = [before, mesh]
    inconsistent := orientation.inconsistent(data.faces, mesh.edges, mesh.edge_faces)
    for: number < int(#mesh.component_faces)
        component := Component(number + 1, mesh.component_faces[number], mesh.component_vertices[number], mesh.component_edges[number])
        component.boundary = mesh.component_boundary[number]
        component.nonmanifold = mesh.component_nonmanifold[number]
        component.bad_vertices = mesh.component_bad_vertices[number]
        component.closed = #component.boundary == 0
        component.manifold = #component.nonmanifold == 0 and #component.bad_vertices == 0
        component.consistent = true
        for edge := component.edges[]
            if has_int(inconsistent, edge)
                component.consistent = false
        component.solid = component.closed and component.manifold and component.consistent
        data.components = data.components.append(component)
    for: number < int(#data.components)
        component := data.components[number]
        if component.solid
            for other := data.components[]
                if not other.solid or other.number == component.number
                    continue
                sample := -1
                for vertex := component.vertices[]
                    if not has_int(other.vertices, vertex)
                        sample = vertex
                        break
                if sample > 0 and measure.winding(other.faces, data.faces, data.points, data.points[sample - 1]) != 0
                    component.inside = component.inside.append(other.number)
        data.components[number] = component
    current_faces = data.faces
    if settings.outward
        for component := data.components[]
            if component.solid
                signed := measure.volume6(component.faces, current_faces, data.points)
                even := #component.inside % 2 == 0
                if signed != 0 and ((even and signed < 0) or (not even and signed > 0))
                    for id := component.faces[]
                        face := current_faces[id - 1]
                        orientation.flip(&face)
                        current_faces[id - 1] = face
                    data.outward_components += 1
    data.faces = current_faces
    for: id < data.initial_faces
        if data.faces[id] != initial[id]
            data.flipped_faces += 1
    copied := data.faces
    orientation.repair(&copied, mesh.edges, mesh.edge_faces)
    not_orientable := orientation.inconsistent(copied, mesh.edges, mesh.edge_faces)
    loop_counts := array(#data.components, fill = 0)
    for loop := coherent_loops(data.faces, mesh.edges, mesh.edge_faces, mesh.component_boundary)[]
        loop_counts[loop.component - 1] += 1
    data.nonplanar = array(#source.polygons, fill = false)
    for: index < int(#source.polygons)
        data.nonplanar[index] = polygon_nonplanar(source.polygons[index], data.snapped)
        if not has_string(data.groups, source.polygon_groups[index])
            data.groups = data.groups.append(source.polygon_groups[index])
    if data.added > 0
        data.groups = data.groups.append("fill")
    shape_names := ["convex", "concave", "flat", "inconsistent"]
    angle_names := ["acute", "right", "obtuse"]
    for: number < int(#data.components)
        component := data.components[number]
        component.orientable = true
        for edge := component.edges[]
            if has_int(not_orientable, edge)
                component.orientable = false
        component.loops = loop_counts[number]
        component.euler = int(#component.vertices) - int(#component.edges) + int(#component.faces)
        component.genus = repair.floor_div(2 - component.euler - component.loops, 2)
        component.crosscaps = 2 - component.euler - component.loops
        component.volume6 = measure.volume6(component.faces, data.faces, data.points)
        component.surface_area = measure.area(component.faces, data.faces, data.points)
        component.bounds = measure.bbox(component.vertices, data.points)
        if component.solid and component.volume6 != 0
            component.center = measure.centroid(component.faces, data.faces, data.points, component.volume6)
        for id := component.faces[]
            direction := measure.normal(data.faces[id - 1], data.points)
            for: axis < 3
                component.normal_sum[axis] += direction[axis]
            kind := measure.angle(data.faces[id - 1], data.points)
            for: index < 3
                if angle_names[index] == kind
                    component.angles[index] += 1
        degree := array(#data.points, fill = 0)
        first_edge := true
        for edge := component.edges[]
            shape := edge_shape(mesh.edges[edge], mesh.edge_faces[edge], data.faces, data.points)
            for: index < 4
                if shape_names[index] == shape
                    component.shapes[index] += 1
            degree[mesh.edges[edge][0] - 1] += 1
            degree[mesh.edges[edge][1] - 1] += 1
            length := measure.length2(mesh.edges[edge], data.points)
            if first_edge or length < component.edge_min
                component.edge_min = length
            if first_edge or length > component.edge_max
                component.edge_max = length
            first_edge = false
        first_vertex := true
        for vertex := component.vertices[]
            value := degree[vertex - 1]
            if first_vertex or value < component.valence_min
                component.valence_min = value
            if first_vertex or value > component.valence_max
                component.valence_max = value
            first_vertex = false
        data.components[number] = component
    return data

string[] boundaries(Data data)
    mesh := data.meshes[0]
    result := ["loops {#data.loops_before}"]
    for loop := data.loops_before[]
        state := if loop.filled then "filled" else "kept"
        result = result.append("loop {loop.number} component {loop.component} length {loop.length} {loop.kind} {state} vertices " + io.listing(loop.vertices))
    int[] bad_edges := []
    for: edge < int(#mesh.edges)
        if #mesh.edge_faces[edge] >= 3
            bad_edges = bad_edges.append(edge)
    result = result.append("nonmanifold_edges {#bad_edges}")
    for edge := bad_edges[]
        result = result.append("edge " + io.listing(mesh.edges[edge]) + " faces " + io.listing(mesh.edge_faces[edge]))
    result = result.append("nonmanifold_vertices {#mesh.nonmanifold_vertices}")
    for vertex := mesh.nonmanifold_vertices[]
        int[] component_numbers := []
        for fan := mesh.fans[vertex - 1][]
            component_numbers = component_numbers.append(mesh.face_components[fan[0] - 1])
        result = result.append("vertex {vertex} fans {#mesh.fans[vertex - 1]} components " + io.listing(unique_sorted(component_numbers)))
    result = result.append("inconsistent_edges {#data.inconsistent_after}")
    for edge := data.inconsistent_after[]
        result = result.append("edge " + io.listing(mesh.edges[edge]) + " faces " + io.listing(mesh.edge_faces[edge]))
    return result

string[] summary(Data data)
    source := data.sources[0]
    int[] sizes := []
    for polygon := source.polygons[]
        sizes = sizes.append(int(#polygon))
    nonplanar_count := 0
    for warped := data.nonplanar[]
        if warped
            nonplanar_count += 1
    merged := 0
    for: index < int(#data.representative)
        if data.representative[index] != index + 1
            merged += 1
    removals := [0, 0, 0]
    removal_names := ["repeated", "zero_area", "duplicate"]
    for reason := data.reasons[]
        for: index < 3
            if removal_names[index] == reason
                removals[index] += 1
    solids := 0
    volume := 0
    for component := data.components[]
        if component.solid
            solids += 1
            volume += component.volume6
    filled := 0
    for loop := data.loops_before[]
        if loop.filled
            filled += 1
    result := [
        "[summary]",
        "lines {source.lines}",
        "vertices {#source.vertices}",
        "polygons {#source.polygons}",
        "errors {#source.errors}",
        "ignored {source.ignored}",
        "nonplanar_polygons {nonplanar_count}",
    ]
    for size := unique_sorted(sizes)[]
        count := 0
        for value := sizes[]
            if value == size
                count += 1
        result = result.append("polygon_size {size} {count}")
    result = result.concat([
        "triangles {#data.triangles}",
        "snapped {#data.snap_records}",
        "merged {merged}",
        "removed_repeated {removals[0]}",
        "removed_zero_area {removals[1]}",
        "removed_duplicate {removals[2]}",
        "faces {data.initial_faces}",
        "inconsistent_before {data.inconsistent_before}",
        "flipped_faces {data.flipped_faces}",
        "outward_components {data.outward_components}",
        "boundary_loops {#data.loops_before}",
        "holes_filled {filled}",
        "fill_faces {data.added}",
        "final_vertices {#data.points}",
        "final_faces {#data.faces}",
        "components {#data.components}",
        "solids {solids}",
        "total_area " + measure.real_text(measure.area(numbers(int(#data.faces)), data.faces, data.points)),
        "total_volume " + measure.fraction(volume, 6),
    ])
    return result

string[] cleanup(Data data)
    source := data.sources[0]
    result := ["[cleanup]", "snapped {#data.snap_records}"]
    for number := data.snap_records[]
        result = result.append("snap {number} " + io.listing(source.vertices[number - 1]) + " to " + io.listing(data.snapped[number - 1]))
    merged := 0
    for: index < int(#data.representative)
        if data.representative[index] != index + 1
            merged += 1
    result = result.append("merged {merged}")
    for: original < int(#data.representative)
        if data.representative[original] != original + 1
            continue
        int[] members := []
        for: index < int(#data.representative)
            if data.representative[index] == original + 1
                members = members.append(index + 1)
        if #members > 1
            number := if data.renumber[original] == 0 then "-" else "{data.renumber[original]}"
            result = result.append("merge {number} " + io.listing(members))
    result = result.append("removed {#data.removed}")
    for: index < int(#data.removed)
        face := data.removed[index]
        result = result.append("remove {face[3]} polygon {face[4]} line {face[5]} " + data.reasons[index])
    return result

string[] components_report(Data data)
    string[] result := []
    for component := data.components[]
        string[] groups := []
        for group := data.groups[]
            present := false
            for id := component.faces[]
                if data.face_groups[id - 1] == group
                    present = true
            if present
                groups = groups.append(group)
        result = result.concat([
            "[component {component.number}]",
            "groups " + groups.join(" "),
            "faces {#component.faces}",
            "vertices {#component.vertices}",
            "edges {#component.edges}",
            "boundary_edges {#component.boundary}",
            "nonmanifold_edges {#component.nonmanifold}",
            "nonmanifold_vertices {#component.bad_vertices}",
            "boundary_loops {component.loops}",
            "closed " + yes(component.closed),
            "manifold " + yes(component.manifold),
            "orientable " + yes(component.orientable),
            "consistent " + yes(component.consistent),
            "solid " + yes(component.solid),
            "euler {component.euler}",
        ])
        result = result.append(if not component.manifold then "genus -" elif component.orientable then "genus {component.genus}" else "crosscaps {component.crosscaps}")
        result = result.concat([
            "volume " + (if component.solid then measure.fraction(component.volume6, 6) else "-"),
            "area " + measure.real_text(component.surface_area),
            "normal_sum " + io.listing(component.normal_sum),
            "bbox " + io.listing(component.bounds),
            "inside " + io.listing(component.inside),
            "centroid " + (if #component.center == 0 then "-" else component.center.join(" ")),
            "convex {component.shapes[0]}",
            "concave {component.shapes[1]}",
            "flat {component.shapes[2]}",
            "acute {component.angles[0]}",
            "right {component.angles[1]}",
            "obtuse {component.angles[2]}",
            "edge_len2 {component.edge_min} {component.edge_max}",
            "valence {component.valence_min} {component.valence_max}",
        ])
    return result

string[] groups_report(Data data)
    source := data.sources[0]
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    string[] result := []
    for group := data.groups[]
        polygons := 0
        triangles := 0
        warped := 0
        int[] ids := []
        int[] parts := []
        for: index < int(#source.polygons)
            if source.polygon_groups[index] == group
                polygons += 1
                if data.nonplanar[index]
                    warped += 1
        for triangle := data.triangles[]
            if source.polygon_groups[triangle[4] - 1] == group
                triangles += 1
        for: index < int(#data.faces)
            if data.face_groups[index] == group
                ids = ids.append(index + 1)
                parts = parts.append(mesh.face_components[index])
        result = result.concat([
            "[group {group}]",
            "polygons {polygons}",
            "triangles {triangles}",
            "nonplanar {warped}",
            "faces {#ids}",
            "area " + measure.real_text(measure.area(ids, data.faces, data.points)),
            "components " + io.listing(unique_sorted(parts)),
        ])
    return result

string[] contacts(Data data)
    result := ["[contacts]"]
    for: first_index < int(#data.components)
        first := data.components[first_index]
        for: first_index + 1 <= second_index < int(#data.components)
            second := data.components[second_index]
            intersects := true
            for: axis < 3
                if first.bounds[axis] > second.bounds[axis + 3] or second.bounds[axis] > first.bounds[axis + 3]
                    intersects = false
            if not intersects
                continue
            shared := 0
            gap := -1
            for vertex := first.vertices[]
                if has_int(second.vertices, vertex)
                    shared += 1
                for other := second.vertices[]
                    if vertex != other
                        delta := measure.subtract(data.points[vertex - 1], data.points[other - 1])
                        distance := measure.dot(delta, delta)
                        if gap < 0 or distance < gap
                            gap = distance
            result = result.append("contact {first.number} {second.number} shared {shared} gap2 {gap}")
    return result

string[] edges_report(Data data)
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    counts := [0, 0, 0]
    shapes := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    shape_names := ["convex", "concave", "flat", "inconsistent"]
    maximum := 0
    shortest := 0
    longest := 0
    low := 0
    high := 0
    for: edge < int(#mesh.edges)
        count := int(#mesh.edge_faces[edge])
        counts[if count < 3 then count - 1 else 2] += 1
        if count > maximum
            maximum = count
        shape := edge_shape(mesh.edges[edge], mesh.edge_faces[edge], data.faces, data.points)
        for: index < 4
            if shape_names[index] == shape
                shapes[index] += 1
        length := measure.length2(mesh.edges[edge], data.points)
        if edge == 0 or length < low
            shortest = edge
            low = length
        if edge == 0 or length > high
            longest = edge
            high = length
    return [
        "[edges]",
        "edges {#mesh.edges}",
        "boundary {counts[0]}",
        "manifold {counts[1]}",
        "nonmanifold {counts[2]}",
        "max_faces {maximum}",
        "convex {shapes[0]}",
        "concave {shapes[1]}",
        "flat {shapes[2]}",
        "inconsistent {shapes[3]}",
        "shortest " + io.listing(mesh.edges[shortest]) + " len2 {low}",
        "longest " + io.listing(mesh.edges[longest]) + " len2 {high}",
    ]

string[] valence(Data data)
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    degree := array(#data.points, fill = 0)
    for edge := mesh.edges[]
        degree[edge[0] - 1] += 1
        degree[edge[1] - 1] += 1
    used := [for value := degree[] if value > 0 then value]
    ordered := used.sorted()
    total := 0
    for value := used[]
        total += value
    result := ["[valence]", "used {#used}", "isolated {#data.points - #used}", "min {ordered[0]}", "max {ordered[-1]}", "mean " + measure.fraction(total, int(#used))]
    for value := unique_sorted(used)[]
        count := 0
        for other := used[]
            if value == other
                count += 1
        result = result.append("degree {value} {count}")
    return result

string query_vertex(int number, Data data)
    if number < 1 or number > int(#data.points)
        return "vertex {number} invalid"
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    count := 0
    degree := 0
    boundary := false
    int[] parts := []
    for: index < int(#data.faces)
        if has_int(data.faces[index][0:<3], number)
            count += 1
            parts = parts.append(mesh.face_components[index])
    for: index < int(#mesh.edges)
        if has_int(mesh.edges[index], number)
            degree += 1
            boundary = boundary or #mesh.edge_faces[index] == 1
    return "vertex {number} at " + io.listing(data.points[number - 1]) + " faces {count} valence {degree} fans {#mesh.fans[number - 1]} boundary " + yes(boundary) + " components " + io.listing(unique_sorted(parts))

string query_face(int number, Data data)
    if number < 1 or number > int(#data.faces)
        return "face {number} invalid"
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    face := data.faces[number - 1]
    string[] neighbors := []
    for pair := orientation.topology.directed(face)[]
        edge := orientation.topology.edge_index(mesh.edges, pair[0], pair[1])
        adjacent := mesh.edge_faces[edge]
        neighbors = neighbors.append(if #adjacent == 1 then "-" elif #adjacent >= 3 then "*" elif adjacent[0] == number then "{adjacent[1]}" else "{adjacent[0]}")
    polygon := if face[4] == 0 then "-" else "{face[4]}"
    line := if face[5] == 0 then "-" else "{face[5]}"
    return "face {number} vertices " + io.listing(face[0:<3]) + " group " + data.face_groups[number - 1] + " polygon {polygon} line {line} component {mesh.face_components[number - 1]} normal " + io.listing(measure.normal(face, data.points)) + " area " + measure.real_text(measure.area([number], data.faces, data.points)) + " neighbors " + neighbors.join(" ")

string query_edge(int first, int second, Data data)
    pair := [first, second]
    pair = pair.sorted()
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    edge := orientation.topology.edge_index(mesh.edges, first, second)
    prefix := "edge " + io.listing(pair)
    if edge < 0
        return prefix + " none"
    count := int(#mesh.edge_faces[edge])
    kind := if count == 1 then "boundary" elif count == 2 then "manifold" else "nonmanifold"
    return prefix + " faces " + io.listing(mesh.edge_faces[edge]) + " kind {kind} shape " + edge_shape(pair, mesh.edge_faces[edge], data.faces, data.points) + " len2 " + "{measure.length2(pair, data.points)}"

string query_point(int[] point, Data data)
    int[] inside := []
    total := 0
    for component := data.components[]
        if component.solid
            winding := measure.winding(component.faces, data.faces, data.points, point)
            if winding != 0
                inside = inside.append(component.number)
                total += winding
    return "point " + io.listing(point) + " inside " + io.listing(inside) + " winding {total}"

string query_path(int start, int target, Data data)
    prefix := "path {start} {target}"
    count := int(#data.points)
    if start < 1 or start > count or target < 1 or target > count
        return prefix + " invalid"
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    int[][] neighbors := array(nat(count), fill = [])
    for edge := mesh.edges[]
        neighbors[edge[0] - 1] = neighbors[edge[0] - 1].append(edge[1])
        neighbors[edge[1] - 1] = neighbors[edge[1] - 1].append(edge[0])
    parent := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    parent[start - 1] = 0
    queue := [start]
    head := 0
    while head < int(#queue)
        current := queue[head]
        head += 1
        for other := neighbors[current - 1].sorted()[]
            if parent[other - 1] < 0
                parent[other - 1] = current
                queue = queue.append(other)
    if parent[target - 1] < 0
        return prefix + " none"
    int[] path := []
    current := target
    while current != 0
        path = path.append(current)
        current = parent[current - 1]
    return prefix + " hops {#path - 1} vertices " + io.listing(path[::-1])

string query_view(int[] direction, Data data)
    mesh := data.meshes[1]
    int[] scores := []
    front := 0
    back := 0
    side := 0
    silhouette := 0
    for face := data.faces[]
        score := measure.dot(measure.normal(face, data.points), direction)
        scores = scores.append(score)
        if score > 0
            front += 1
        elif score < 0
            back += 1
        else
            side += 1
    for adjacent := mesh.edge_faces[]
        if #adjacent == 2 and ((scores[adjacent[0] - 1] > 0 and scores[adjacent[1] - 1] < 0) or (scores[adjacent[0] - 1] < 0 and scores[adjacent[1] - 1] > 0))
            silhouette += 1
    return "view " + io.listing(direction) + " front {front} back {back} side {side} silhouette {silhouette}"

string[] queries(Data data)
    settings := data.parameters[0]
    result := ["[queries]"]
    for query := settings.queries[]
        args := query.args
        answer := if query.kind == "vertex" then query_vertex(args[0], data) elif query.kind == "face" then query_face(args[0], data) elif query.kind == "edge" then query_edge(args[0], args[1], data) elif query.kind == "point" then query_point(args, data) elif query.kind == "path" then query_path(args[0], args[1], data) else query_view(args, data)
        result = result.append(answer)
    return result

string[] components_csv(Data data)
    result := ["component,faces,vertices,closed,euler,genus,volume6,area"]

            "{component.number}",

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 square_root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

int[] subtract(int[] first, int[] second)
    return [first[0] - second[0], first[1] - second[1], first[2] - second[2]]

int dot(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first[0] * second[0] + first[1] * second[1] + first[2] * second[2]

int[] cross(int[] first, int[] second)
    return [first[1] * second[2] - first[2] * second[1], first[2] * second[0] - first[0] * second[2], first[0] * second[1] - first[1] * second[0]]

int[] normal(int[] face, int[][] points)
    return cross(subtract(points[face[1] - 1], points[face[0] - 1]), subtract(points[face[2] - 1], points[face[0] - 1]))

int determinant(int[] face, int[][] points)
    return dot(points[face[0] - 1], cross(points[face[1] - 1], points[face[2] - 1]))

real64 area(int[] ids, int[][] faces, int[][] points)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for id := ids[]
        direction := normal(faces[id - 1], points)
        total += square_root(as_real(dot(direction, direction)))
    return total / 2.0

int length2(int[] edge, int[][] points)
    delta := subtract(points[edge[0] - 1], points[edge[1] - 1])
    return dot(delta, delta)

string angle(int[] face, int[][] points)
    first := points[face[0] - 1]
    second := points[face[1] - 1]
    third := points[face[2] - 1]
    smallest := dot(subtract(second, first), subtract(third, first))
    other := dot(subtract(third, second), subtract(first, second))
    if other < smallest
        smallest = other
    other = dot(subtract(first, third), subtract(second, third))
    if other < smallest
        smallest = other
    return if smallest < 0 then "obtuse" elif smallest == 0 then "right" else "acute"

int volume6(int[] ids, int[][] faces, int[][] points)
    total := 0
    for id := ids[]
        total += determinant(faces[id - 1], points)
    return total

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    first := if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    numerator /= first
    denominator /= first
    return if denominator == 1 then "{numerator}" else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

string real_text(real64 value)
    result := "{value:.3}"
    return if result == "-0.000" then "0.000" else result

string[] centroid(int[] ids, int[][] faces, int[][] points, int signed_volume)
    string[] result := []
    for: axis < 3
        total := 0
        for id := ids[]
            face := faces[id - 1]
            total += determinant(face, points) * (points[face[0] - 1][axis] + points[face[1] - 1][axis] + points[face[2] - 1][axis])
        result = result.append(fraction(total, 4 * signed_volume))
    return result

int[] bbox(int[] vertices, int[][] points)
    result := points[vertices[0] - 1].concat(points[vertices[0] - 1])
    for vertex := vertices[]
        for: axis < 3
            if points[vertex - 1][axis] < result[axis]
                result[axis] = points[vertex - 1][axis]
            if points[vertex - 1][axis] > result[axis + 3]
                result[axis + 3] = points[vertex - 1][axis]
    return result

real64 arctangent(real64 value)
    negative := value < 0.0
    reduced := if negative then -value else value
    reciprocal := reduced > 1.0
    if reciprocal
        reduced = 1.0 / reduced
    real64 offset := 0.0
    if reduced > 0.4142135623730950488
        reduced = (reduced - 1.0) / (reduced + 1.0)
        offset = 0.7853981633974483096
    term := reduced
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: index < 40
        total += term / as_real(2 * index + 1)
        term *= -reduced * reduced
    total += offset
    if reciprocal
        total = 1.5707963267948966192 - total
    return if negative then -total else total

real64 angle2(real64 vertical, real64 horizontal)
    if horizontal > 0.0
        return arctangent(vertical / horizontal)
    if horizontal < 0.0
        result := arctangent(vertical / horizontal)
        return if vertical >= 0.0 then result + 3.141592653589793 else result - 3.141592653589793
    return if vertical > 0.0 then 1.5707963267948966192 elif vertical < 0.0 then -1.5707963267948966192 else 0.0

int winding(int[] ids, int[][] faces, int[][] points, int[] sample)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for id := ids[]
        face := faces[id - 1]
        first := subtract(points[face[0] - 1], sample)
        second := subtract(points[face[1] - 1], sample)
        third := subtract(points[face[2] - 1], sample)
        length_first := square_root(as_real(dot(first, first)))
        length_second := square_root(as_real(dot(second, second)))
        length_third := square_root(as_real(dot(third, third)))
        numerator := as_real(dot(first, cross(second, third)))
        denominator := length_first * length_second * length_third + as_real(dot(first, second)) * length_third + as_real(dot(second, third)) * length_first + as_real(dot(third, first)) * length_second
        total += 2.0 * angle2(numerator, denominator)
    rounded := total / (4.0 * 3.141592653589793) + 0.5
    result := math.floor(rounded)
    return result

bool has_string(string[] values, string target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

bool integer_word(string word)
    digits := if word.starts_with("-") then word[1:<int(#word)] else word
    if digits == ""
        return false
    for: index < int(#digits)
        if not "0123456789".contains(digits[index])
            return false
    return true

int decimal(string word)
    negative := word.starts_with("-")
    value := 0
    for: (if negative then 1 else 0) <= index < int(#word)
        digit := int(word[index])
        value = value * 10 + digit
    return if negative then -value else value

string listing(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return if #fields == 0 then "-" else fields.join(" ")

class Source()
    lines := 0
    int[][] vertices := []
    int[][] polygons := []
    int[] polygon_lines := []
    string[] polygon_groups := []
    string[] errors := []
    ignored := 0

Source read_obj()
    source := Source()
    group := "default"
    lines := read_lines("input/model.obj")
    source.lines = int(#lines)
    ignored_keywords := ["vt", "vn", "s", "o", "usemtl", "mtllib"]
    for: index < int(#lines)
        line := lines[index]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        keyword := words[0]
        args := words[1:<int(#words)]
        reason := ""
        if keyword == "v"
            valid := #args == 3
            for word := args[]
                valid = valid and integer_word(word)
            if valid
                source.vertices = source.vertices.append([decimal(args[0]), decimal(args[1]), decimal(args[2])])
            else
                reason = "bad_vertex"
        elif keyword == "f"
            if #args < 3
                reason = "short_face"
            else
                int[] vertices := []
                for reference := args[]
                    part := reference.split("/")[0]
                    if not integer_word(part) or decimal(part) == 0
                        reason = "bad_index"
                        break
                    number := decimal(part)
                    if number < 0
                        number = int(#source.vertices) + 1 + number
                    if number < 1 or number > int(#source.vertices)
                        reason = "out_of_range"
                        break
                    vertices = vertices.append(number)
                if reason == ""
                    source.polygons = source.polygons.append(vertices)
                    source.polygon_lines = source.polygon_lines.append(index + 1)
                    source.polygon_groups = source.polygon_groups.append(group)
        elif keyword == "g"
            group = if #args > 0 then args[0] else "default"
        elif has_string(ignored_keywords, keyword)
            source.ignored += 1
        else
            reason = "unknown_keyword"
        if reason != ""
            source.errors = source.errors.append("line {index + 1} {reason}")
    return source

string[] repaired(int[][] points, int[][] faces, string[] groups)

    for point := points[]
        result = result.append("v " + listing(point))
    previous := ""
    for: index < int(#faces)
        if groups[index] != previous
            result = result.append("g " + groups[index])
            previous = groups[index]
        result = result.append("f " + listing(faces[index][0:<3]))
    return result

public import topology = "./topology.qui"

bool has_directed(int[] face, int first, int second)
    for edge := topology.directed(face)[]
        if edge[0] == first and edge[1] == second
            return true
    return false

void flip(int[] &face)
    saved := face[1]
    face[1] = face[2]
    face[2] = saved

int[] inconsistent(int[][] faces, int[][] edges, int[][] edge_faces)
    int[] result := []
    for: index < int(#edges)
        adjacent := edge_faces[index]
        if #adjacent == 2 and has_directed(faces[adjacent[0] - 1], edges[index][0], edges[index][1]) == has_directed(faces[adjacent[1] - 1], edges[index][0], edges[index][1])
            result = result.append(index)
    return result

void repair(int[][] &faces, int[][] edges, int[][] edge_faces)
    visited := array(#faces, fill = false)
    for: 1 <= seed <= int(#faces)
        if visited[seed - 1]
            continue
        visited[seed - 1] = true
        queue := [seed]
        head := 0
        while head < int(#queue)
            current := queue[head]
            head += 1
            pairs := topology.directed(faces[current - 1])
            for pair := pairs[]
                index := topology.edge_index(edges, pair[0], pair[1])
                adjacent := edge_faces[index]
                if #adjacent != 2
                    continue
                other := if adjacent[0] == current then adjacent[1] else adjacent[0]
                if not visited[other - 1]
                    if has_directed(faces[other - 1], pair[0], pair[1])
                        changed := faces[other - 1]
                        flip(&changed)
                        faces[other - 1] = changed
                    visited[other - 1] = true
                    queue = queue.append(other)

bool has_face(int[][] values, int[] target)

int[][] split_polygons(int[][] polygons, int[] lines)

    for: polygon < int(#polygons)
        corners := polygons[polygon]
        for: 1 <= index < int(#corners) - 1
            triangles = triangles.append([corners[0], corners[index], corners[index + 1], int(#triangles) + 1, polygon + 1, lines[polygon]])
    return triangles

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    return if numerator % denominator < 0 then quotient - 1 else quotient

class Snapped(int[][] points, int[] changed)

Snapped snap(int[][] vertices, int spacing)
    int[][] points := []
    int[] changed := []
    for: number < int(#vertices)
        point := vertices[number]
        int[] rounded := []
        for coordinate := point[]
            rounded = rounded.append(spacing * floor_div(2 * coordinate + spacing, 2 * spacing))
        points = points.append(rounded)
        if rounded != point
            changed = changed.append(number + 1)
    return Snapped(points, changed)

int[] representatives(int[][] points, bool merge)
    int[] result := []
    for: number < int(#points)
        owner := number
        if merge
            for: earlier < number
                if points[earlier] == points[number]
                    owner = earlier
                    break
        result = result.append(owner + 1)
    return result

class Cleaned(int[][] faces, int[][] removed, string[] reasons)

Cleaned clean(int[][] triangles, int[][] points, int[] representative, bool remove_zero, bool remove_duplicate)
    int[][] faces := []
    int[][] removed := []
    string[] reasons := []
    int[][] seen := []
    for triangle := triangles[]
        face := triangle
        for: axis < 3
            face[axis] = representative[face[axis] - 1]
        reason := ""
        if face[0] == face[1] or face[1] == face[2] or face[2] == face[0]
            reason = "repeated"
        elif remove_zero
            direction := measure.normal(face, points)
            if direction == [0, 0, 0]
                reason = "zero_area"
        if reason == ""
            ordered := face[0:<3].sorted()
            if remove_duplicate and has_face(seen, ordered)
                reason = "duplicate"
            else
                seen = seen.append(ordered)
        if reason == ""
            faces = faces.append(face)
        else
            removed = removed.append(triangle)
            reasons = reasons.append(reason)
    return Cleaned(faces, removed, reasons)

int[][] filling(int[] corners)
    int[][] result := []
    for: 2 <= index < int(#corners)
        result = result.append([corners[0], corners[index], corners[index - 1], 0, 0, 0])
    return result

bool has_int(int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

int[][] directed(int[] face)
    return [[face[0], face[1]], [face[1], face[2]], [face[2], face[0]]]

int edge_index(int[][] edges, int first, int second)
    low := if first < second then first else second
    high := if first < second then second else first
    for: index < int(#edges)
        if edges[index][0] == low and edges[index][1] == high
            return index
    return -1

int[][] connected(int[] selected, int[][] neighbors, int count)
    visited := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    int[][] parts := []
    for seed := selected[]
        if visited[seed - 1]
            continue
        queue := [seed]
        visited[seed - 1] = true
        head := 0
        while head < int(#queue)
            current := queue[head]
            head += 1
            for other := neighbors[current - 1][]
                if not visited[other - 1]
                    visited[other - 1] = true
                    queue = queue.append(other)
        parts = parts.append(queue.sorted())
    return parts

class Mesh(int[][] edges, int[][] edge_faces, int[] face_components, int[][] component_faces, int[][] component_vertices, int[][] component_edges, int[][] component_boundary, int[][] component_nonmanifold, int[][] component_bad_vertices, int[][][] fans, int[] nonmanifold_vertices, int[] used)

Mesh analyze(int[][] faces, int vertex_count)
    int[][] edges := []
    int[][] edge_faces := []
    int[][] neighbors := array(#faces, fill = [])
    int[] used := []
    for: id < int(#faces)
        for vertex := faces[id][0:<3][]
            if not has_int(used, vertex)
                used = used.append(vertex)
        for pair := directed(faces[id])[]
            index := edge_index(edges, pair[0], pair[1])
            if index < 0
                edges = edges.append(pair.sorted())
                edge_faces = edge_faces.append([])
                index = int(#edges) - 1
            edge_faces[index] = edge_faces[index].append(id + 1)
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#edges)
        place := int(#order)
        order = order.append(index)
        while place > 0 and (edges[index][0] < edges[order[place - 1]][0] or (edges[index][0] == edges[order[place - 1]][0] and edges[index][1] < edges[order[place - 1]][1]))
            order[place] = order[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        order[place] = index
    int[][] ordered_edges := []
    int[][] ordered_faces := []
    for index := order[]
        ordered_edges = ordered_edges.append(edges[index])
        ordered_faces = ordered_faces.append(edge_faces[index])
    edges = ordered_edges
    edge_faces = ordered_faces
    for adjacent := edge_faces[]
        for first := adjacent[]
            for second := adjacent[]
                if first != second and not has_int(neighbors[first - 1], second)
                    neighbors[first - 1] = neighbors[first - 1].append(second)
    for: index < int(#neighbors)
        neighbors[index] = neighbors[index].sorted()
    int[] all_faces := []
    for: 1 <= index <= int(#faces)
        all_faces = all_faces.append(index)
    component_faces := connected(all_faces, neighbors, int(#faces))
    face_components := array(#faces, fill = 0)
    int[][] component_vertices := []
    int[][] component_edges := []
    int[][] component_boundary := []
    int[][] component_nonmanifold := []
    int[][] component_bad_vertices := []
    for: number < int(#component_faces)
        int[] vertices := []
        for id := component_faces[number][]
            face_components[id - 1] = number + 1
            for vertex := faces[id - 1][0:<3][]
                if not has_int(vertices, vertex)
                    vertices = vertices.append(vertex)
        component_vertices = component_vertices.append(vertices.sorted())
        component_edges = component_edges.append([])
        component_boundary = component_boundary.append([])
        component_nonmanifold = component_nonmanifold.append([])
        component_bad_vertices = component_bad_vertices.append([])
    for: index < int(#edges)
        number := face_components[edge_faces[index][0] - 1] - 1
        component_edges[number] = component_edges[number].append(index)
        if #edge_faces[index] == 1
            component_boundary[number] = component_boundary[number].append(index)
        elif #edge_faces[index] >= 3
            component_nonmanifold[number] = component_nonmanifold[number].append(index)
    used = used.sorted()
    int[][][] fans := array(nat(vertex_count), fill = [])
    int[] nonmanifold_vertices := []
    for vertex := used[]
        int[] containing := []
        int[][] local_neighbors := array(#faces, fill = [])
        for: id < int(#faces)
            if has_int(faces[id][0:<3], vertex)
                containing = containing.append(id + 1)
        for: index < int(#edges)
            if has_int(edges[index], vertex)
                for first := edge_faces[index][]
                    for second := edge_faces[index][]
                        if first != second and not has_int(local_neighbors[first - 1], second)
                            local_neighbors[first - 1] = local_neighbors[first - 1].append(second)
        for: index < int(#local_neighbors)
            local_neighbors[index] = local_neighbors[index].sorted()
        parts := connected(containing, local_neighbors, int(#faces))
        fans[vertex - 1] = parts
        if #parts >= 2
            nonmanifold_vertices = nonmanifold_vertices.append(vertex)
        counts := array(#component_faces, fill = 0)
        for part := parts[]
            counts[face_components[part[0] - 1] - 1] += 1
        for: number < int(#counts)
            if counts[number] >= 2
                component_bad_vertices[number] = component_bad_vertices[number].append(vertex)
    return Mesh(edges, edge_faces, face_components, component_faces, component_vertices, component_edges, component_boundary, component_nonmanifold, component_bad_vertices, fans, nonmanifold_vertices, used)

class Loop(int number, int component, int[] vertices, int length, string kind)
    filled := false

Loop[] trace_loops(int[][] edges, int[][] component_boundary)
    Loop[] result := []
    for: number < int(#component_boundary)
        unused := array(#edges, fill = false)
        for index := component_boundary[number][]
            unused[index] = true
        for first := component_boundary[number][]
            if not unused[first]
                continue
            unused[first] = false
            sequence := edges[first]
            current := sequence[1]
            while current != sequence[0]
                chosen := -1
                other := -1
                for index := component_boundary[number][]
                    next_vertex := if edges[index][0] == current then edges[index][1] elif edges[index][1] == current then edges[index][0] else -1
                    if unused[index] and next_vertex >= 0 and (other < 0 or next_vertex < other)
                        chosen = index
                        other = next_vertex
                if chosen < 0
                    break
                unused[chosen] = false
                sequence = sequence.append(other)
                current = other
            length := int(#sequence) - 1
            closed := current == sequence[0]
            if closed
                sequence = sequence[0:<length]
            result = result.append(Loop(int(#result) + 1, number + 1, sequence, length, if closed then "closed" else "open"))
    return result
